description: Get a technical indicator (RSI, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands or VWAP) for one token, computed server-side from the token's USD candles across every pool it trades in on the network (the same series as getTokenOHLCV), returned as a time series. Read-only. Runs on the caller's own Dev, Pro or Enterprise API key, set as the Authorization header on the connection to this server; without one it returns DP401_API_KEY_REQUIRED and sends nothing upstream, and a free key gets 403. In either case fall back to getPoolIndicator on the token's most liquid pool, found with getTokenPools sorted by volume. Values come oldest first, one per completed candle: rsi, ema and vwap return `value`; macd returns `macd`, `signal` and `histogram`; bbands returns `upper`, `middle` and `lower`. RSI over 70 is commonly read as overbought and under 30 as oversold; a MACD histogram that changes sign means MACD crossed its signal line. RSI, EMA and MACD are smoothed, so start at least ten periods before the first value you rely on. Params: network (required); token_address (required); indicator (required): 'rsi', 'ema', 'macd', 'bbands' or 'vwap'; interval (pass it every time: '1m','5m','10m','15m','30m','1h','6h','12h','24h' or '1d'); start (optional; a relative offset such as '-24h' or '-7d', Unix seconds, RFC3339 or yyyy-mm-dd; without it you get the last `limit` values); end (optional, exclusive); limit (default 100, max 1000); cursor (next_cursor of the previous page, not with start); period for rsi (default 14), ema (20), bbands (20) and vwap (14); fast_period (12), slow_period (26) and signal_period (9) for macd only; std_dev (2) for bbands only. A parameter that belongs to another indicator is refused.

cursor.description: OPTIONAL: next_cursor from the previous page. Do not combine with start

end.description: OPTIONAL: End of the range, exclusive, same formats as start. Defaults to now

fast_period.description: OPTIONAL, macd only: fast EMA period (default 12)

interval.description: Candle interval the indicator is computed on. Pass it every time; '1d' equals '24h'

period.description: OPTIONAL: rsi (default 14), ema (default 20), bbands (default 20), vwap (default 14). Not for macd

rationale.description: REQUIRED. 1-2 sentence rationale for this call (e.g. "User asked for X; calling Y to fetch Z"). Logged for MCP improvement, never shown to end users. No PII or secrets. See the server `instructions` field for the full convention and worked examples.

signal_period.description: OPTIONAL, macd only: signal line period (default 9)

slow_period.description: OPTIONAL, macd only: slow EMA period (default 26), must be above fast_period

start.description: OPTIONAL: First candle. A relative offset from now is simplest: '-24h', '-7d' (units s, m, h, d). Also Unix seconds, RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD. Without it you get the last `limit` values

std_dev.description: OPTIONAL, bbands only: band width in standard deviations (default 2)

name: getTokenIndicator

data.description: One value per completed candle, oldest first.

histogram.description: macd minus signal; a sign change is a crossover.

timestamp.description: Open time of the candle, RFC3339.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; empty on the last page.
